label: Magic
depicts: Magic wand bar with one top square tip and three sparkle stars around
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain wand bar with several separate sparkle stars around it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the star wand or burst wand when the wand should not cross a large symbol.

label: Magic Hat
depicts: Wizard hat with a round brim and two sparkle stars above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a pointed wizard hat with sparkles floating above the brim.
avoid_when: Do not use for the top hat when the opening should look flat and circular inside the brim.

label: Magic Hat
depicts: Top hat with one circular opening above a tapered lower body and sparkle stars
use_when: Use when the interface wants a magician top hat with an open ring at the top and sparkles above.
avoid_when: Do not use for the pointed wizard hat when the crown should rise into one sharp tip.

label: Assistant Message
depicts: Rounded message face with two centered dots and one sparkle star at upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded face like message mark with a sparkle at the upper right.
avoid_when: Do not use for the text bubble AI mark when inner text bars should replace the face dots.

label: Assistant Message
depicts: Text bubble frame with two inner bars and one sparkle star at upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a standard text bubble with sparkle rather than a face styled message.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded face AI bubble when two dot eyes should appear inside the shape.
